question: Why couldn't the Egyptians just use one long, straight ramp?
answer: A straight ramp has to climb all the way to the top of the pyramid, so it becomes a giant wedge of its own. That wedge ends up taking more stone than the pyramid itself. The best guess is that the Egyptians used a ramp wrapped around the pyramid instead.
move: A straight ramp to the top outgrows the pyramid it serves.
